descriptionChirho: A proper territorial name designating the region of Bashan, east of the Jordan River, originally the kingdom of Og. The name refers to a fertile highland plateau encompassing modern-day Golan Heights and Hauran. Used throughout the Pentateuch, historical books, Psalms, and prophets with various prepositional prefixes (in Bashan, from Bashan, and Bashan) and the article, all denoting the same geographical territory.
